# waxcut

> Frame-accurate, lossless MP3 splitting and duration parsing in pure Python — no ffmpeg, no subprocess, no decode step. Cuts are made by parsing the file's own MPEG frame headers and byte-copying whole frames, so output is bit-identical to the source, just shorter.

Install: `pip install waxcut` or `uv add waxcut`. Zero runtime dependencies.

## Docs

- [Getting Started](https://waxcut.pages.dev/docs/getting-started): install and usage, including `split_at` for N-way splits
- [API Reference](https://waxcut.pages.dev/docs/api-reference): every public function/class — signature, args, returns, raises
- [How It Works](https://waxcut.pages.dev/docs/how-it-works): why frame-based splitting is safe; VBR, ID3v2, and LAME gapless handling
- [Security](https://waxcut.pages.dev/docs/security): fuzzing, OpenSSF Scorecard, vulnerability reporting

## Optional

- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/jkeychan/waxcut): source, issues, CONTRIBUTING.md
